stem.text: The mass of a block of melting ice, measured in kilograms, is modeled by a twice-differentiable function M of time t, measured in minutes. It is known that \( M''(8) = 5 \). Using correct units, interpret the meaning of \( M''(8) = 5 \) in the context of the problem.

answer_key.label: At time t = 8 minutes, the rate at which the mass of the block of ice is changing is increasing at a rate of 5 kilograms per minute per minute.

worked_solution.text: \( M''(8) \) is the rate of change of \( M' \), the rate at which the mass of the block of ice changes, so it is measured in kilograms per minute per minute.
worked_solution.rule_named: second derivative as the rate of change of a rate

worked_solution.text: The value is positive, so at t = 8 the rate of change of the mass of the block of ice is itself increasing, by 5 kilograms per minute for each minute.
worked_solution.rule_named: sign of the second derivative gives the direction of change of the rate
